faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Senior Project Scientist / Senior Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the IIT Kanpur Senior Project Scientist / Senior Project Engineer recruitment is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Project Scientist / Senior Project Engineer positions?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Senior Project Scientist / Senior Project Engineer positions at IIT Kanpur through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. You must prepare your application with all required documents and send it to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Senior Project Scientist / Senior Project Engineer roles will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 38,800 to Rs. 96,400.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria include a Ph.D / M.Tech / M.E. / M.S. / M.Sc. / MCA in specific disciplines with relevant experience, or a B.Tech / B.E. / B.S. in allied engineering disciplines with 2 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive as per the available information.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Project Scientist / Senior Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will primarily involve an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Kanpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur is located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 208016.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the institute.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is highly recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.
